summary: This diff adds a new GET /api/v1/projexa/module-chain route plus a full test suite, both purely additive with no existing files touched. The route correctly reuses the established requireAuthOrApiKey/requireRoleOrScope auth pattern from the sibling /api/v1/projexa/capability-tree route, and tenant isolation is sound because it delegates entirely to buildCapabilityTree(), which itself wraps all queries in withTenantContext({orgId}) keyed off the authenticated caller's own orgId -- there is no request-supplied orgId anywhere in this route, so cross-tenant bleed is structurally impossible. The construction_intelligence filter is verified correct against the real buildConstructionNodes() key in capability-tree-service.ts. Most importantly for this re-audit's purpose, the test file's mockTree() helper correctly applies the mock.module regression fix from commit 74632493 (spreading the real module's exports via `{...actual, buildCapabilityTree}` before overriding), and no other test file in the repo mocks capability-tree-service, so there is no sibling-test pollution risk. No auth, schema, migration, or workflow files are touched.
